# `base/toggle`

A control holds a pressed state, alone or as one of a mutually exclusive group.

## Selection

- **Use when:** A control holds a pressed state, alone or as one of a mutually exclusive group.
- **Avoid when:** The state is a form value that submits, or the control performs an action.
- **Consider instead:** `base/choice-inputs`, `base/buttons`
- **Stability:** stable.

## Import

```tsx fragment — import-only example
import { Toggle } from "themelia-ui/base/toggle"
import "themelia-ui/base/toggle.css"
```

## Composition

This family has no component-family dependencies.

outside the package and arrives through the public props, callbacks, slots, or accessors below.

### `ToggleGroup`

Kind: callable.

A set of `Toggle`s (each given a `value`) sharing one value. `multiple` makes it a
checkbox set rather than one-at-a-time.

```text
({ attached, className, ...props }: ToggleGroupProps) => import("react").JSX.Element
```

Kind: interface.

Extends: `ToggleGroupPrimitive.Props`.

| member | required | type | description / documented default |

| `attached` | no | `boolean` | Joins the toggles into one framed control. Defaults to true. |
